bbox_note: bbox_pct values are approximate (estimated by eye) and are only meant for matching regions; x, y = top-left, w, h = size, in percent of the page.
excluded: Nothing excluded; no page number is printed.
page_notes: Horror story on dark panels, but every balloon is a white balloon with dark lettering. Mix of upright and italic/bold emphasis lettering. Several stray specks in the scan sit next to letters (noted per region).

regions.text: AAIIEE! MY THROAT! HELP ME, JOHN!
regions.notes: 'AAIIEE!' is a red/black display scream inside the balloon (a sound-effect style word). Its letters are stylised; the third and fourth glyphs read as two I's, one with an apostrophe-like tick, so the spelling AAIIEE is my best reading. 'THROAT!' is italic.

regions.text: TAKE IT EASY, ALICE! THAT WAS A MINE RAT! THEY'RE HALF STARVED--WE HAVE TO BE CAREFUL!
IT BIT ME, JOHN! LET'S TURN BACK- THIS PLACE IS HORRIBLE!
regions.notes: 'BACK-' ends a line with a single dash used as punctuation (not a word break). 'HORRIBLE!' is bold italic.

regions.text: BUT THEY WENT ON..A THOUSAND FEET DOWN INTO THE DEEP PIT! AND THEN...
regions.notes: Dark italic on a yellow scroll caption; red drop initial 'B'. A dot-like speck between DEEP and PIT is treated as print noise.

regions.text: GO BACK! HERE THERE IS ONLY LIVING DEATH!
THAT VOICE --IT SOUNDS LIKE IT'S COMING FROM THE GRAVE!
IT'S PROBABLY EVARTS PLAYING A PRACTICAL JOKE!
BUT WHY SHOULD HE WANT TO KEEP US FROM OPENING THE MINE? IT WOULD GIVE HIM HIS OLD JOB BACK AGAIN.
regions.notes: A speck before the '?' after MINE and a tick after JOB are print noise, not apostrophes.

regions.text: I DON'T KNOW, BUT I'M GOING TO FIND OUT.
THE LANTERN SMASHED--AND ALICE WADE HEARD THE SICKENING THUD OF WOOD ON BONE--THEN THERE WAS DARKNESS, AND THE QUICK WHISPER OF RUNNING FEET IN THE STYGIAN BLACKNESS!
regions.notes: Dark italic on yellow; red drop initial 'T'. The double dashes end their lines ('SMASHED--', 'BONE--'); spacing around them is not significant. A dot between WHISPER and OF is print noise.

regions.text: JOHN, OH, DARLING, PLEASE SPEAK TO ME!
